component.name: Antigravity IDE
component.summary: Advanced AI-Powered Agentic Coding & Development Suite

description.p: This Linux wrapper/installer from Wheelhouser LLC simplifies and automates the installation of Antigravity IDE, Google's next-generation integrated development environment and intelligent coding companion. Powered by cutting-edge autonomous AI agentic architecture, Antigravity IDE empowers developers to create, debug, refactor, and test complex software systems with unprecedented speed, precision, and confidence.

Whether you are building cross-platform Linux desktop applications, microservices, or cloud-native architectures, Antigravity IDE streamlines your workflow with deep system integration, proactive AI pairing, and multi-distro build automation.
Key features and capabilities:

ul.li: Autonomous Pair Programming: Collaborate in real-time with multi-model AI coding agents that plan, write code, run tests, and diagnose issues.
Cross-Platform Packaging & Build Orchestration: Native support for Linux (RPM, DEB), macOS, and Windows packaging pipelines.
Comprehensive Language Ecosystem: Full syntax highlighting, intelligent autocompletion, and language server protocol integration across Python, Rust, C/C++, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, and more.
Integrated Terminal & Process Manager: Built-in high-performance terminal emulator with multi-tab support and background task management.
Native Desktop Integration: Fully compliant with GNOME, KDE, and modern Linux desktop environments with Wayland and X11 support, high-DPI scaling, and modern dark themes.
Zero-Friction Staging & Deployment: Streamlined candidate staging and live network deployment capabilities through Wheelhouser Orchestra.

description.p: Learn more, view comprehensive documentation, and connect with the developer community on the official Wheelhouser website and developer portal.

description.p: Release 1.0.0-38: Eliminate obsolete libXScrnSaver/libxss dependency to support clean installation on Enterprise Linux 10 without requiring EPEL.
Release 1.0.0-37: Align StartupWMClass with window app_id for native Wayland window tracking and enforce reverse-DNS desktop shortcut convention (com.wheelhouser.antigravity-ide.desktop).
Release 1.0.0-36: Remove all aggressive process termination, fix wrapper archive variable initialization, and add pre-extracted payload discovery.
Release 1.0.0-35: Eliminate corrupt downloads by validating gzip archive integrity, remove rogue local router IP, and add automatic discovery of local Downloads cache.
Release 1.0.0-34: Point store hero banner to canonical URL, and extend post-install cleanup to automatically eliminate legacy desktop launchers.
Release 1.0.0-33: Deploy updated flagship store hero banner with multi-distro badges and force GNOME Software screenshot cache refresh.
Release 1.0.0-32: Unify single canonical reverse-DNS desktop launcher, eliminate duplicate settings entries, provide full AppStream releases history, and add scalable SVG/HiDPI icon assets.
Release 1.0.0-31: Add scalable vector SVGs in hicolor/scalable/apps and /usr/share/pixmaps, 1024x1024 HiDPI icons, and automated cache updater.
Release 1.0.0-30: Standardize release number macro per AGENTS-BUILD.md specifications and multi-distro build matrix synchronization.
Release 1.0.0-29: Fix GNOME Software Center metadata linking, restore primary AppStream desktop ID, add GnomeSoftware::FeatureTile hero banner, and deploy interactive desktop shortcuts.
Release 1.0.0-28: Harmonize package and AppStream descriptions with Google wrapper details and synchronize multi-distro build matrix.
Release 1.0.0-27: Clarify application description and Google packaging details, harmonize build-linux orchestration scripts, and update staging distribution endpoints.
Release 1.0.0-26: Complete AppStream 1.0 software center metadata suite, expanded screenshot gallery, dual reverse-DNS desktop launchers, and full hicolor icons.

ul.li: Full AppStream 1.0 specification compliance verified across GNOME Software and KDE Discover.
Enriched visual assets including 1920x1080 store hero banner, high-DPI icons, and screenshots.
Dual desktop launcher integration supporting both legacy CLI aliases and modern reverse-DNS IDs.

description.p: Release 1.0.0-25: Multi-distro package build harmonization and automated QA verification across Fedora, Rocky, Alma, Debian, and Ubuntu.
Release 1.0.0-24: Add AppStream Software Center metadata, store hero banner, complete hicolor icon suite (16x16 to 512x512), dynamic launcher self-healing, and expanded desktop integration.
Release 1.0.0-23: Dynamic first-run payload deployment and local Staging Hub network cache support.
Release 1.0.0-22: Add native Debian 13 (Trixie) and Ubuntu 24 (.deb) packaging and build support.
Release 1.0.0-21: Official AlmaLinux 10 and Rocky Linux 10 packaging harmonization.
